description: This file defines an Angular component named TreeNodeComponent used for rendering and interacting with nodes in a tree UI structure, including icons, expand/collapse functionality, and pinning.

classes.name: TreeNodeComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying individual tree nodes with expand/collapse, pin, and icon features.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties and updates CSS classes accordingly.

methods.name: isPropertiesTreeNode
methods.description: Determines if the current node is a properties node (not HierarchyTreeNode).

methods.name: showPinNodeIcon
methods.description: Checks whether to display the pin icon for the node.

methods.name: toggleTree
methods.description: Emits an event to toggle the collapsed state of the node.

methods.name: showChevron
methods.description: Determines if the chevron (expand/collapse arrow) should be shown.

methods.name: showLeafNodeIcon
methods.description: Determines if the leaf node icon should be shown.

methods.name: expandTree
methods.description: Emits an event to expand the node.

methods.name: pinNode
methods.description: Emits an event to pin the node.

methods.name: updateCollapseDiffClass
methods.description: Updates CSS class based on the diff types of child nodes.

methods.name: getAllDiffTypesOfChildren
methods.description: Recursively gets all diff types present in the children of a given node.
